sentences.text:
Order 
This is second bail application filed under section 439 of Cr.P.C in crime no.318/2023 registered at police station Panwasa District Ujjain under section 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(N), 376(2)(k) of IPC and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
The earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive the same after the statement of witnesses in support of the scholar register.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecution has examined the Incharge Principal of the school PW No.6.
Though, she has not stated that on what basis the entry regarding the date of birth of the prosecutrix was made in the scholar register.

Learned counsel for the respondent/state and the objector opposed the 2 MCRC-26806-2024 prayer and submits that the prosecutrix has supported the prosecution case and as per the scholar register, the date of birth of the prosecutrix is 04.09.2006.
Thus, she was minor on the date of the incident.
At this stage, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present application.
Accordingly, the present application stands dismissed as withdrawn.
